coverageLevelDefinitions.1: Level 1 native smoke — launch, routing, identity, controls render, safe exit
coverageLevelDefinitions.2: Level 2 native interaction — valid/invalid input submitted, feedback/round-advance observed
coverageLevelDefinitions.3: Level 3 full lifecycle — a whole session ended (win OR fail) with final results shown
coverageLevelDefinitions.4: Level 4 resilience — background/relaunch, interruption, a11y profiles, offline
